blocks.text: V, Jimin, J-Hope and Jin of K-pop supergroup BTS once again donned their military uniforms during their break from the “Arirang” world tour, as they attended their annual reserve force training. In South Korea, men who completed their mandatory military service are required to attend annual brief reserve forces trainings for a certain number of years. V shared a series of photos featuring himself in the uniform through his Instagram page on Thursday, Nov. 12. “I just live like this,” he said in Korean.
